```{python}

```

## PIPELINES 
```{python}
lr_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [("standardize", StandardScaler()),
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
)

lr_pipeline
```

## COLUMN TRANSFORMERS
```{python}
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer

ct = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
    ("standardize", StandardScaler(), ["Gr Liv Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
)


lr_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [("preprocessing", ct),
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
)

lr_pipeline
```

```{python}
X = ames.drop("SalePrice", axis = 1)
y = ames["SalePrice"]



X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y)

lr_fitted = lr_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)
```


```{python}
ct_inter = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("interaction", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["Gr Liv Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")

ct_inter.fit_transform(X_train)
```


```{python}
ct_dummies = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"])],
  remainder = "passthrough"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")

ct_inter = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("interaction", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["remainder__TotRms AbvGrd", "dummify__Bldg Type_1Fam"]),
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")

X_train_dummified = ct_dummies.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_dummified
```


```{python}
lr2_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [("dummify", ct_dummies),
  ("interaction", ct_inter), 
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
)

lr2_pipeline

lr2_fitted = lr2_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)
lr2_newdata=lr2_pipeline.predict(X_test, y_test)
```

Using size and building type, and their interaction.

defined from before:
```{python}
ct_select= ColumnTransformer(
    [("dropstuff", "passthrough", ["Lot Area", "Bldg Type"])],
    remainder="drop"
)

ct_dummies = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"])],
  remainder = "passthrough"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")


ct_inter2 = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("interaction", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["remainder__Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_1Fam"]),
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
sizetypeint_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [("select", ct_select),
  ("dummify", ct_dummies),
  ("interaction2", ct_inter2),
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

Using a 5-degree polynomial on size, a 5-degree polynomial on number of rooms, and also building type.


## CROSS VALIDATION 

```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score

X = ames.drop("SalePrice", axis = 1)
y = ames["SalePrice"]


ct = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
    ("standardize", StandardScaler(), ["Gr Liv Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
)

lr_pipeline_1 = Pipeline(
  [("preprocessing", ct),
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
).set_output(transform="pandas")


scores = cross_val_score(lr_pipeline_1, X, y, cv=5, scoring='r2') #each model/pipeline is tested against the data 5 times
scores
```


```{python}
scores.mean()
```

we have a cross validated r square values of 0.533


POLYNOMIAL STUFF
```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV

ct_poly = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
    ("polynomial", PolynomialFeatures(), ["Gr Liv Area"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
)

lr_pipeline_poly = Pipeline(
  [("preprocessing", ct_poly),
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
).set_output(transform="pandas")

degrees = {'preprocessing__polynomial__degree': np.arange(1, 10)}

gscv = GridSearchCV(lr_pipeline_poly, degrees, cv = 5, scoring='r2')
```
